subject: Re: CSA/CAIQ submission & evidence owners — Winterhold Capital
messages:
From: Winterhold Security <security@winterholdcapital.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CSA/CAIQ: Evidence request and timeline for procurement

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. As discussed, procurement needs a completed CAIQ (CSA Consensus Assessment Initiative Questionnaire) mapped to our internal control IDs and supporting evidence for the due diligence review. Key asks we have:

- Completed CAIQ spreadsheet (all questions answered) with control mapping to CC/Sec/Resilience families.
- Evidence attachments (policies, config exports, screenshots, certs) for high-impact controls: CC-1 (data classification), SC-3 (encryption at rest), SI-7 (logging/alerting).
- Confirmation of latest SOC 2 report availability and date range.
- A single shared link to the evidence bundle or secure upload.

Target deadline for our side: 2026-11-25 EOD. If that timeline is tight, tell us the minimum viable package we can present to procurement.

Thanks — please loop whoever owns infra and identity.

Jane Dobson
Head of Vendor Risk
Winterhold Capital
security@winterholdcapital.com

Attachment: Winterhold_CA_Request_20261118.pdf (pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Winterhold Security <security@winterholdcapital.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CSA/CAIQ: Evidence request and timeline for procurement

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list and the timeline. We can meet the 11/25 date with an internal cutoff on 11/24 to assemble and sanity-check deliverables. Plan and owners below: 

- CAIQ answers: Laura (compile + QA) — I will use the attached template and add references to our control registry.
- Infra evidence (SC-3, SI-7 exports, config snapshots): Markus — he will pull screenshots, config dumps, and ephemeral access logs.
- Identity & access controls (CC-1, IA controls): Monica — will supply IAM policies, role summaries, and MFA attestations.
- Encryption details & key management: Rishi — will provide KMS key policy and encryption-at-rest design note.

Deliverables we will produce by 2026-11-24 17:00 PST (internal):
- CAIQ_Response_Template_20261118.xlsx (completed answers + control mapping)
- Evidence bundle (zipped with named files and readme) + a single Google Drive share link
- SOC 2 bridge letter / latest report reference (if permitted)

Please confirm if a redacted SOC 2 or a SOC 2 letter is acceptable for procurement, and whether they require notarized/attested PDFs. If procurement wants additional attestation, ping me and we'll escalate.

Attachments: CAIQ_Response_Template_20261118.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CSA/CAIQ: Evidence request and timeline for procurement

Laura / team — I started an infra evidence checklist and synced with InfraOps. Quick notes: 

- I will extract RDS/S3 configuration exports and control screenshots for SC-3 and SI-7. Expect partial exports by 11/20 and final artifacts by 11/23.
- We are missing long-term retention proof for CC-1. Current retention is enforced via lifecycle policies; however, we need a compact report showing applied policies and a sample object life history. I'll run an S3 object lifecycle audit and include the CSV.
- For logging evidence: I'll include a CloudTrail export (last 90 days) and our alerting playbook snippet. Some logs are large — I'll provide filtered extracts with timestamps for the events referenced in the CAIQ answers.

I uploaded a working folder and an infra readme: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqX-CAIQ-WHC-evidence (internal link)

Attachment: infra_evidence_readme.md (text)

-Markus
Head of Infrastructure Security
markus_klein@redwood.com
